title: Pairs
statementMd:
There are $*n*$ students in Polycarp's class (including himself). A few days ago all students wrote an essay "My best friend". Each student's essay was dedicated to one of the students of class, to his/her best friend. Note that student $*b*$'s best friend is not necessarily student $*a*$, if $*a*$'s best friend is $*b*$.

And now the teacher leads the whole class to the museum of the history of sports programming. Exciting stories of legendary heroes await the students: tourist, Petr, tomek, SnapDragon — that's who they will hear about!

The teacher decided to divide students into pairs so that each pair consisted of a student and his best friend. She may not be able to split all the students into pairs, it's not a problem — she wants to pick out the maximum number of such pairs. If there is more than one variant of doing so, she wants to pick out the pairs so that there were as much boy-girl pairs as possible. Of course, each student must not be included in more than one pair.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$), $*n*$ is the number of students per class. Next, $*n*$ lines contain information about the students, one per line. Each line contains two integers $*f*_{*i*}, *s*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *f*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, *f*_{*i*} ≠ *i*, 1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 2$), where $*f*_{*i*}$ is the number of $*i*$-th student's best friend and $*s*_{*i*}$ denotes the $*i*$-th pupil's sex ($*s*_{*i*} = 1$ for a boy and $*s*_{*i*} = 2$ for a girl).

## Output

Print on the first line two numbers $*t*$, $*e*$, where $*t*$ is the maximum number of formed pairs, and $*e*$ is the maximum number of boy-girl type pairs among them. Then print $*t*$ lines, each line must contain a pair $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$), they are numbers of pupils in the $*i*$-th pair. Print the pairs in any order. Print the numbers in pairs in any order. If there are several solutions, output any of them.

## Note

The picture corresponds to the first sample. On the picture rhomb stand for boys, squares stand for girls, arrows lead from a pupil to his/her best friend. Bold non-dashed arrows stand for pairs in the answer.

statementZhMd:
班级中有 $*n*$ 名学生（包括 Polycarp）。几天前，所有学生都写了一篇题为“我最好的朋友”的作文。每名学生的作文都献给班级中的一名学生，即他/她最好的朋友。注意，如果学生 $*a*$ 最好的朋友是 $*b*$，那么学生 $*b*$ 最好的朋友不一定是学生 $*a*$。

现在，老师要带全班去参观体育编程历史博物馆。传奇英雄们的精彩故事正等待着学生们：tourist、Petr、tomek、SnapDragon——他们将听到这些人的故事！

老师决定将学生分成若干对，使得每一对都由一名学生和他/她最好的朋友组成。她可能无法将所有学生都分成这样的配对，这并不重要——她希望选出数量最多的配对。如果有多种方案，她希望选出的配对中男女配对的数量尽可能多。当然，每名学生至多只能出现在一个配对中。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示班级中的学生人数。接下来的 $*n*$ 行每行包含一名学生的信息。每行包含两个整数 $*f*_{*i*}, *s*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *f*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, *f*_{*i*} ≠ *i*, 1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 2$），其中 $*f*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 名学生最好的朋友的编号，$*s*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 名学生的性别（$*s*_{*i*} = 1$ 表示男生，$*s*_{*i*} = 2$ 表示女生）。

## 输出格式

第一行输出两个数 $*t*$、$*e*$，其中 $*t*$ 是组成的配对数量的最大值，$*e*$ 是其中男女配对数量的最大值。接下来输出 $*t*$ 行，每行包含一对 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），表示第 $*i*$ 对中学生的编号。配对可以按任意顺序输出，每对中的两个编号也可以按任意顺序输出。如果有多个解，输出其中任意一个即可。

## 说明

图片对应第一个样例。图中的菱形表示男生，正方形表示女生，箭头从一名学生指向他/她最好的朋友。答案中的配对用加粗的非虚线箭头表示。
